8th Pay Commission discussions focus on potential salary increases

Discussions surrounding the 8th Pay Commission are exploring significant potential salary hikes for government employees. Proposals suggest increases in allowances like House Rent Allowance (HRA), Travel Allowance (TA), and Dearness Allowance (DA) could boost pay, with some projections indicating rises over 60% for certain levels. The commission's recommendations will impact a large segment of the Indian workforce.
